# EggPdf

> Zero-dependency HTML/CSS to PDF rendering engine for .NET. Pure C#, MIT license, Chrome-quality output.

Built by Eggspot (https://eggspot.app). Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/eggspot/EggPdf

## Docs
- [Getting Started](https://eggspot.github.io/EggPdf/getting-started.html)
- [Docker Guide](https://eggspot.github.io/EggPdf/docker.html)
- [CLI Guide](https://eggspot.github.io/EggPdf/cli.html)
- [REST API](https://eggspot.github.io/EggPdf/rest-api.html)
- [PDF Compliance](https://eggspot.github.io/EggPdf/compliance.html)
- [Full docs (GitHub Wiki)](https://github.com/eggspot/EggPdf/wiki)
- [AI/LLM usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eggspot/EggPdf/main/llms.txt)

## Install
```
dotnet add package EggPdf
```

## Quick example
```csharp
using EggPdf;
byte[] pdf = await HtmlToPdf.RenderAsync("<h1>Hello</h1>");
await File.WriteAllBytesAsync("output.pdf", pdf);
```

## Page size, margins, headers/footers
Set with CSS, not an options object — `@page` for size/margin, `position: fixed` for running
headers/footers (repeats on every page), `counter(page)`/`counter(pages)` for page numbers:
```csharp
string html = @"
    <html><head><style>
        @page { size: A4; margin: 20mm 15mm; }
        .footer { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; }
        .footer::after { content: ""Page "" counter(page) "" of "" counter(pages); }
    </style></head>
    <body><div class=""footer""></div><h1>My Document</h1></body></html>";
byte[] pdf = await HtmlToPdf.RenderAsync(html);
```

## REST API (any language)
```bash
docker run -p 8080:8080 eggspot/eggpdf:latest
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/render \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"html": "<h1>Hello</h1>"}' -o output.pdf
```

## Webfonts & Unicode
- Google Fonts / remote `<link>` stylesheets fetched automatically; @font-face over http(s), data:, or files
- Weight-accurate faces (300–900), real font metrics, full Vietnamese/extended Latin, symbol fallback (⚠ ✔)

## Security
```csharp
// One-call PKI signing (detached CMS/PKCS#7, zero extra packages)
byte[] signed = EggPdf.Pdf.PdfSigner.Sign(pdf, x509CertWithPrivateKey,
    new EggPdf.Pdf.PdfSigner.SignOptions { Name = "Jane", Reason = "Approval" });
```
- View-only PDFs: `HtmlToPdf.Render(html, new PdfEncryption {...})` or REST `POST /api/encrypt` (RC4 128-bit, owner/user passwords, print/copy/modify flags)
- Permission flags are advisory; signatures give cryptographic tamper evidence

## Performance
- Simple page: 13 µs — Invoice: 86 µs — Large table (100 rows): 1.2 ms
- Thread-safe, streaming output, zero allocations on hot path

## Compliance
- PDF/A-1b/1a/2b/2u/2a/3b/3u/3a: `HtmlToPdf.Render(html, PdfAConformance.PdfA2b)` — embedded ICC output intent, XMP metadata, every font embedded with a correct ToUnicode mapping. PDF/A-1 has no `u` level (only `a`/`b`, unlike parts 2/3). The `a` levels require `tagged: true` (level A is PDF/A + full accessibility tagging)
- PDF/UA-1 tagged PDF: `HtmlToPdf.Render(html, tagged: true)` — structure tree, alt text, `/Lang`, `/MarkInfo`, combinable with PDF/A conformance
- ZUGFeRD/Factur-X e-invoicing, MINIMUM profile: `HtmlToPdf.Render(html, PdfAConformance.PdfA3b, invoice)` — embeds the CII invoice XML as a PDF/A-3 attachment
- Not yet implemented: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X BASIC/EN16931/EXTENDED profiles, PDF/UA-2 — see [PDF Compliance](https://eggspot.github.io/EggPdf/compliance.html)

## Target frameworks
netstandard2.0, netstandard2.1, net6.0, net8.0, net9.0, net10.0
